title: AI Access
subtitle: Connect AI agents to Todo for AI via Skill, MCP, or OpenClaw

skill.title: Skill-based Integration
skill.description: Best for autonomous agents. The platform provides a standard Skill Markdown so agents can authenticate, pull tasks, renew leases, commit results, and append logs.
skill.alertDescription: Use Skill + HTTP API Token for the most complete integration capabilities.
steps: Create an Agent in the platform and generate credentials
Provide the Skill Markdown to the Agent as runtime instructions
Use /agent/auth/introspect to exchange key for short-lived access token
Complete execution flow with pull/events/commit/logs endpoints

mcp.title: MCP Integration
mcp.description: Fast onboarding for MCP-capable clients such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Cline.
recommendations: Use least-privilege tokens and rotate periodically

openclaw.title: OpenClaw/HTTP Integration
openclaw.description: For custom runtimes. The HTTP protocol supports pull-based execution, lease renewal, event streaming, idempotent commits, and task logs.
openclaw.notice: OpenClaw integration must strictly follow lease and idempotency rules to avoid update races.

overview.title: MCP Integration Overview
overview.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the standard protocol between AI assistants and external tools. Once connected, your assistant can claim platform tasks, submit results, and sync task status.

whatIsMcp.title: What MCP enables
whatIsMcp.description: Through MCP your assistant can: claim tasks automatically, update execution status, submit evidence-backed results, and read project context and rules.
whatIsMcp.features: Claim tasks · Submit results · Sync status · Read context

requirements.title: Before you start
requirements.ide: A supported AI assistant: Claude Code / Cursor, etc.
requirements.token: A platform API Token (create it in Settings)
requirements.backend: A reachable Todo for AI service URL

alert.message: Make sure Node.js 18+ is installed first
alert.description: The install command relies on npx, which ships with Node.js 18+.

description.linkText: create an API Token in Settings

second.title: Step 2: Pick your assistant
second.description: Open the tab for your assistant and follow the steps.

items.restart: Restart your assistant so it loads the MCP config
items.testCommand: Ask it to run a test task from the platform
items.verify: Check the task status updates on the platform

claude.title: Claude Code integration
claude.description: Register the Todo for AI MCP server in Claude Code.

editConfig.title: Edit the config
editConfig.description: Add the Todo for AI entry under mcpServers — or paste the command above to write it automatically.

restart.title: Restart Claude Code
restart.description: Restart Claude Code after saving so the MCP server takes effect.

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: Ask Claude to claim a platform task; its status should switch to in progress.

cursor.title: Cursor integration
cursor.description: Add the Todo for AI server in Cursor's MCP settings.

openSettings.title: Open MCP settings
openSettings.description: Cursor → Settings → MCP → Add new MCP server.

addServer.title: Add the server
addServer.name: Set the name to todo-for-ai
addServer.type: Choose SSE and paste the platform URL
addServer.command: Or copy the command below to write it automatically

save.title: Save and connect
save.description: Cursor connects to the MCP server automatically after saving.

useInChat.title: Use it in chat
useInChat.description: Tell Cursor to "claim a platform task" and it starts working for you.

configuration.title: Environment variables
configuration.description: The MCP server supports these variables. All have defaults; usually no change needed.

envVars.title: Available variables
envVars.description: Pass them when launching the MCP server.

apiBaseUrl.description: Platform API base URL. Default: https://todo4ai.org/todo-for-ai/api/v1

apiToken.description: API token — equivalent to the token param in the MCP config; use either

logLevel.description: Log level: debug / info / warn / error. Default: info

security.title: Security note
security.tips: A token acts as your account identity: never commit it to a repository. If leaked, revoke and recreate it in Settings.

otherIdes.title: Other AI assistants
otherIdes.description: Any MCP-compatible client can connect to Todo for AI.

genericConfig.title: Generic configuration
genericConfig.description: Fill in the service URL (SSE) and API token per the MCP standard. See the Environment variables section for field meanings.

testing.title: Testing & support
testing.description: After connecting, run an end-to-end check: create a test task and let your assistant claim and submit it.
